aggregation_caveat: per-well K bands; descriptive channel aggregates have no chi-squared null
alignment: SynergyRun.aligned: reporter interpolated to OD timestamps
ancestor_semantics: number of surviving initial particle labels; not restored by process noise
blank_correction: constant mean across recorded/selected blank wells and all times
ess_semantics: ess is posterior/pre-resampling; post_resample_ess is not particle diversity
initialization: finite positive opening OD for biomass/log-growth and finite opening RFU with positive mean concentration; legacy_full_trace additionally needs positive full-trace OD; initialization rows labelled and normally unscored
intervals: one-step Gaussian moment approximation to the particle mixture, not exact mixture quantiles

measurement_noise.floor_role: numerical reference-scale floor in each channel's units; not an instrument noise measurement

population.ledger: one row per (export, well), retaining absent recorded wells; well=null is a plate-level exclusion, not a biological denominator entry; recorded_role is independent of status
population.outside_layout: never culture candidates, including when explicitly selected by --well
population.recorded: recorded_for_export: only RecordedPlate.culture_wells are culture candidates; selected blank references are not scored
population.scope: source_set after plate selection; before well selection, smoke cap or data refusals
population.unknown_layout: shared nonblank wells are exploratory only; explicit blank selectors or legacy_low_od are required without recorded blanks

reading_policy.finite_values: retain signed OD and RFU, including zero and negative readings
reading_policy.infinity: refuse well with field and original step indices
reading_policy.initialization: positive physical-prior initialization is a separate requirement, not a reading filter
reading_policy.name: finite_gaussian
reading_policy.nan: omit only the missing channel at its original step
